values: Year-end snapshots. 2026 uses the latest completed local-market close.
Source: Bloomberg Desktop API, retrieved 22-Sep-2026. Historical BEST_PE_RATIO with fixed target-calendar-year BC overrides.
Definition: price at observation date divided by adjusted consensus EPS for CY Y+2, using the historical consensus then available.
N/M = zero or negative EPS. Pre-IPO = not yet listed. Private = SailPoint was privately owned at the observation date.
SailPoint 2018-2021: original listing, 2542797D US Equity. 2025-2026: new listing, SAIL US Equity. Capital structures differ.
Large positive multiples are retained. Bloomberg calendarization is distinct from fiscal-year or rolling-24-month P/E.
Values are quoted from Bloomberg. Display: one decimal. Stored numeric values retain source precision.
